economy.summary: Her campaign supports programs to lower the costs of housing, childcare, insurance, utilities, and other expenses, and to restore assistance initiatives such as the Whole Home Repairs Program and rental assistance to keep families stable.
economy.short: Supports lowering housing, childcare, utility costs; restoring assistance programs.

abortion.summary: She says she intends to codify the right to choose into state law and to ensure reproductive healthcare decisions remain between a patient and their doctor, including access to IVF and family planning services.
abortion.short: Intends to codify right to choose; protect IVF, family planning.

education.summary: She supports implementing the Fair Funding Formula so every public school district receives resources for a strong education, and increasing funding for special education, gifted programs, and Career and Technical Education.
education.short: Supports Fair Funding Formula; more special education, CTE funding.

healthcare.summary: She says healthcare is a human right and every Pennsylvanian deserves comprehensive coverage, and she prioritizes mandating mental health coverage and working to lower prescription drug costs.
healthcare.short: Says healthcare is a human right; supports mandating mental health coverage.

energy.summary: She says she will support wind and solar energy to create local jobs and will back Governor Shapiro's bipartisan Lightning Plan to provide clean, accessible energy.
energy.short: Supports wind and solar energy; backs Shapiro's Lightning Plan.
